Check existing issues before opening a new request.

## Problem

Describe the problem or limitation you want to address.

## Proposed solution

Explain the improvement and how you expect it to work.

## Educational value

Explain how this supports the project's educational purpose while keeping it simple.

## Alternatives considered (optional)

Describe any simpler approaches or workarounds you considered.

## Additional context (optional)

Add examples, relevant links, or screenshots that help explain the request.
